english.title: Assault prisoner custody officer acting in pursuance of prisoner escort arrangements
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) assaulted **(..SPECIFY PERSON..) a prisoner custody officer acting in pursuance of prisoner escort arrangements
english.legislation: Contrary to section 90(1) of the Criminal Justice Act 1991.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
assaulted

investigatoraction.description: DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
(i) Section 17(2) of the Firearms Act 1968 (additional penalty for possession of firearms when committing certain offences) applies to this offence - in those circumstances See the offence wordings H4354 re firearms, H4355 re shotguns and H4356 re air weapons.
(ii) A prisoner custody officer must be readily identifiable as such when acting in pursuance of prisoner escort arrangements - see section 90(4).
(iii) See the charging standards relating to assault.
(iv) Section 40(3) of the Criminal Justice Act 1988 was amended by the Criminal Justice and Public Order Act 1994 (Paragraph 35 Schedule 9) to include an offence under this section. This allows the offence to be added to an indictment if necessary.
(v) See also associated offence wordings H4406 and H4407.

other.penalty:
Six months imprisonment and / or a fine not exceeding level five on the standard scale.
(See note (iv) concerning mode of trial)

Time limit for prosecutions:
6 months

On the 12th March 2015 the limit on fines imposed by a Magistrates’ court was removed – as such, the potential fine on summary conviction in relation to an offence committed after this date is unlimited.
